html:
The Kingdom of Hawaii was the island state of the Polynesian people of Hawaii, from 1795 to 1893. Kamehameha I conquered most of the islands in 1795, and Kauai joined in 1810.

After his death the court ended the old kapu system in 1819, and American Protestant missionaries arrived the next year. The kingdom adopted a constitution in 1840. A land reform in 1848, the Great Māhele, let foreigners buy land. Sugar plantations spread, worked by labourers from China, Portugal and Japan (Japanese migration to Hawaii). Foreign diseases cut the Native Hawaiian population sharply.

In 1887 white planters forced King Kalākaua to accept the "Bayonet Constitution", which took power from the crown. In 1893 a group of American businessmen, backed by United States Marines, overthrew Queen Liliʻuokalani (overthrow of the Hawaiian Kingdom). The United States annexed the islands in 1898.
